title: The Joy Luck Club
author: Amy Tan
summary: Four Chinese immigrant mothers who meet weekly to play mahjong, and their American-born daughters, take turns telling the stories that explain their relationships with each other.
readIf: you like linked stories about mothers and daughters and the things that get lost between generations.
skipIf: you prefer a single narrator and a continuous plot over a rotating cast of voices.

pairings.reason: Another American novel about immigrant parents and a child who feels caught between two worlds.
Shares the focus on women's lives under rigid social expectations in an East Asian setting.
Also gives different women space to tell their stories, ending in a similar sense of hard-won warmth.
